== English errata comparison sources ==
The Limited face has the original attachment wording. The 29 January 2002 Decipher Glossary Supplement (PDF page 8) prints the intermediate wording in italics and follows it with a separate ruling. The 2013 Players Committee errata sheet and 2023 Appendix A print the Parasite wording. The Revised physical face remains a separate printing. The Dark Side 2013 slip heading and cutout label carry a bullet. Both checked complete Dark Side PC faces and the original face show a title without a bullet, and the 2023 entry supplies no uniqueness change.
